name: saban-skills
description: Three skills built on Nick Saban's approach: process planning, 24-hour reviews, and roster building.

interface.shortDescription: Process planning, 24-hour reviews, and roster building, Saban style.
interface.longDescription: Turn a big goal into daily standards you control, review wins and losses the same way within 24 hours, and pick people and prospects against a written list of critical factors.
defaultPrompt: I need to hit $400K in new business by Q3. Build me the process.
I lost a big renewal today. Run the 24-hour review.
Here are five prospects. Grade them like Saban would grade recruits.
